Team —

I reviewed Atlas_OrderForm_v3.docx. High-level notes (will send formal redline PDF next):
- Term: 24 months ok from commercial — legal needs to confirm SLA coverage/prorations for mid-term capacity increases (we typically align billing bands to the renewal anniversary).
- Exhibit A: need clearer per-region definitions (region codes vs. geography). Request: replace free-text "EMEA-West"/"US-East-Lite" with explicit cloud-region IDs and attach an operations runbook entry for data residency.
- Liability and Indemnity: Atlas added back a carveout re: third-party data processors. We should propose language that preserves our standard MSA indemnity but acknowledges customer data handling constraints (I will propose the exact text).
- Pricing: the orderform references "list pricing except as noted" — will mark explicit overridden tiers and the discount band.

I’m attaching the first-pass redline for Exhibit A (redline_exhibitA.pdf). Please review comments in sections 2 and 4.

Kimberly

Thanks for the rapid review. A couple clarifications:
- Atlas can swap the region labels for explicit cloud-region IDs (we'll provide the mapping by EOD).
- On indemnity: we can accept language that keeps Redwood's standard MSA indemnity, provided Atlas can maintain a limited processor carveout that reflects our contractual obligations to our downstream customers.
- Billing/proration: Procurement prefers predictable monthly invoicing rather than anniversary adjustments — is there a way to reconcile that with Redwood's billing bands?

If you can share proposed redline text for the indemnity carveout and a short note on invoicing options (monthly vs. anniversary-based), we can expedite internal approvals.

Tom
Director, Strategic Ops — Atlas Data Systems

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@atlasdata.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@atlasdata.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jul 2027 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed uplift + term alignment (proposed language + billing options)

Tom / Elena —

Attached below is the redline excerpt we recommend for the MSA indemnity / processor carveout (excerpt copied into the PDF attachment):
- Proposed: "Notwithstanding Section X.X, Customer shall be responsible for claims arising from Customer's obligations to its downstream customers where such obligations are expressly required by law or contract, provided Customer uses commercially reasonable safeguards. Redwood remains responsible for breaches of the Services platform."

Billing/proration options: two viable paths:
1) Monthly invoicing with fixed monthly commitment: Redwood will amortize the annual committed value over monthly invoices. Any capacity adjustments mid-term will be billed in the month they occur pro rata. (preferred for procurement predictability)
2) Anniversary banding (standard): increased capacity is folded into the next billing band at the contract anniversary with true-up.

Recommendation: accept monthly invoicing for this deal (we can support it operationally) but require a minimum 30-day notice for each phase and a 7-day ramp buffer for provisioning. That preserves predictable cash flows for Atlas and gives ops time to schedule capacity.

I’ll send the finalized redline PDF (with the excerpt inserted into the MSA) and a clean OrderForm for signature once we have confirmation on region IDs.

Kimberly
[Attachment: redline_exhibitA_final.pdf (pdf)]
